pr.title: DataSources: Send generateName with requests from the UI
pr.body:
This reverts https://github.com/grafana/grafana/pull/123802 and requires sending `name` or `generateName` on POST request.

This is the k8s rationale for this design choice:
https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/main/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#idempotency
